description: React functional component for editing notes, including state management, save mechanics with debounce and interval guards, and UI rendering.

methods.name: NoteEditor
methods.description: Main React component for the note editing interface with save, delete, and UI logic.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles input change for note's title and content, marks fields as dirty.

methods.name: maybeBlurSave
methods.description: Schedules a debounced save when input loses focus.

methods.name: doSave
methods.description: Performs save operation with optimistic UI update and debouncing to prevent rapid saves.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Deletes the current note and navigates back to notes list.
